usage: A tropical fruit with a sweet and slightly sour taste
Often eaten fresh, cut into pieces, or used in dishes and drinks
Commonly sold whole or already cut in markets
Frequently described by sweetness, sourness, and freshness
Very common in everyday Cantonese food conversations
